summary: The frame changes by audience; the facts never do. Use only verified proof points (see the proof-points payload), keep the state vocabulary intact (live / merged-not-deployed / planned), and never invent metrics, users, revenue, or endorsements. GRANT JUDGES select for a real problem, an underserved founder and audience, a credible plan for this money, and measurable outcomes. iFund's honest strengths: a woman founder-developer in STEM building the tool herself; creators underserved by a design-and-marketing skill gap; funds mapped to specific costs (platform infrastructure, AI service costs, outreach to first cohorts); success in countable terms (campaigns created, creators served, outcomes tracked in verified-versus-reported terms). Model paragraph (full text in the brief): 'Interplanetary Fund is a woman-owned, woman-developed fundraising platform built by a solo founder in Everett, Washington — a software development student who is the company's developer, architect, and operator... The product is live and pre-revenue; this funding would cover the platform infrastructure, AI service costs, and outreach that carry it to its first cohorts of creators, with outcomes tracked and reported in verified-versus-reported terms from day one.' INVESTORS select for market, model, a founder who ships, and a believable path to traction. Honest frame: fundraising is mass-market with a skill bottleneck the product removes; revenue pairs premium subscriptions with a 7% fee taken only at withdrawal on first-party campaigns; partner-first distribution avoids a platform war; the founder shipped a live platform solo on free-tier infrastructure with zero recurring burn. Honest stage: pre-revenue, pre-traction — sell the path (first cohorts, subscriber conversion, verified outcome data as the moat), never invented traction. PARTNERS select for incremental value without channel conflict, clean compliance, technical seriousness. Lead with the guarantees: supporters complete giving at the partner's own authorised checkout; iFund never custodies outside-platform funds and takes no fee on them; integrations are claimed only at the level actually authorised (public link, OAuth, API, webhook are separate labelled states); external publishing always requires the campaign owner's explicit confirmation. THE PUBLIC gets the simple version — what it is, who it helps, an invitation — with the discretion rules applied without exception: 'Fundraising is hard to do well alone. Interplanetary Fund gives every creator a team: AI helpers that shape your story, make your images and video, and guide your campaign — in one place, built for your phone, by a founder who needed it herself.' Full text with complete model paragraphs: executiveagent/docs/IFUND_MASTER_BRIEF.md section (f).
title: Interplanetary Fund — audience framing for grant judges, investors, partners, and the public
